item.title: 2 Centre County School Districts Announce Delays for Wednesday
item.description: Some Centre County schools will have a delayed start on Wednesday because of continuing frigid temperatures. State College and Philipsburg-Osceola school districts on Tuesday night both announced two-hour delays for Wednesday. Centre County is under a cold weather advisory through 10 a.m. on Wednesday, with temperatures dropping near zero overnight and wind chill values as low as -15 degrees, according to the National Weather Service. item.description: Penn State remained atop the latest NWCA Coaches Poll released on Tuesday, while six Nittany Lion wrestlers maintained their No. 1 individual InterMat rankings. item.title: Two Centre County School Districts to Operate on 2-Hour Delay Thursday and Friday
item.description: Students in two Centre County school districts will have delayed starts for the remainder of the week as extreme cold temperatures persist throughout the area. State College and Philipsburg-Osceola school districts announced on Wednesday that they will have two-hour delays Thursday and Friday because of the cold weather advisory issued by the National Weather Service and frigid temperatures expected both mornings. item.title: New Benner Pike Hotel Celebrates Opening
item.description: Local business and tourism leaders celebrated the opening of Centre County's newest hotel along the booming Benner PIke corridor with a ribbon-cutting on Thursday morning. item.title: Bellefonte B&B Wins International Sustainability Award
item.description: A Bellefonte bed and breakfast has achieved a major recognition for its environmental care.
